tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a known workspace file or a specific line range.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories in the workspace when their paths are not yet known.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search workspace file names or file contents for text, symbols, or patterns.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new workspace file or replace a complete file with supplied content.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Apply a precise patch to an existing workspace file.

tools.name: bash
tools.description: Run an explicitly approved shell command or pipeline in the workspace.

tools.name: run_process
tools.description: Run an allowlisted executable such as git, cargo, npm, or rg without a shell.

tools.name: ipython
tools.description: Use a persistent Python kernel for data analysis, calculations, and charts.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Persist a user instruction only when the user explicitly asks Mimir to remember it.

tools.name: extension_invoke
tools.description: Invoke one installed native extension operation by its registered extension and action names.

tools.name: github_search_code
tools.description: Search code, commits, issues, and pull requests in connected GitHub repositories.

tools.name: github_create_pull_request
tools.description: Create a GitHub pull request from an already pushed branch with a title and body.

tools.name: linear_search_issues
tools.description: Search and read issues in connected Linear workspaces.

tools.name: linear_create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a connected Linear team with a title and description.

tools.name: slack_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages and threads in connected Slack workspaces.

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a specified Slack channel or thread.

tools.name: calendar_list_events
tools.description: List events from a connected calendar for a specified time range.

tools.name: calendar_create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event with attendees, title, and start and end times.

tools.name: browser_open_page
tools.description: Open a web page in the controlled browser and inspect its rendered content.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click or interact with an element on the currently controlled browser page.
